candidates: 65 W USB-C charger for a laptop

electrical_fixture.doc: Base for hardwired electrical fixtures (panels, outlets, detector bases).

breaker_panel.doc: Load center: door hides the breakers (children with relation 'part'); label_text is the handwritten panel directory.

circuit_breaker.doc: Thermal-magnetic branch breaker. Tripped handle rests mid-way; a reset needs full OFF then ON (reset_breaker). Panel work is risk 3.

main_breaker.doc: Service disconnect: OFF de-energizes every branch circuit.

wall_outlet.doc: Duplex receptacle on a branch circuit (circuit = breaker id). Hidden _fault: 'arcing' (buzzes, warms, scorches) or 'open' (dead).

gfci_outlet.doc: Ground-fault receptacle: trips on a ground fault (wet appliance, water); RESET via reset_breaker. Protects load-side outlets (gfci_protected_by).

outdoor_outlet.doc: Weatherproof in-use cover receptacle with GFCI.

plug_device.doc: Anything with a mains plug and cord. outlet/socket name where it is plugged; cord_cells/cord_hazard are the routed cord.

power_strip.doc: Six-outlet surge strip, 15 A rated with a resettable breaker. Never daisy-chain; high-draw appliances belong on a wall outlet.

extension_cord.doc: 25 ft 16 AWG indoor cord (13 A). Heats when loaded while coiled; no overcurrent protection of its own.

smart_plug.doc: Wi-Fi plug-in relay; the relay setting (app) switches the load.

outlet_timer.doc: Plug-in timer: passes power between on_time and off_time in auto mode (house looks occupied).

travel_adapter.doc: Changes plug shape only (no voltage conversion).

television.doc: Smart TV with HDMI inputs (HDMI 2 = ARC). display shows the active source, 'no_signal', 'intermittent', 'standby' or 'off'.

game_console.doc: power_state off/rest/on; rest mode can still power USB ports for controller charging. Cutting power mid-update corrupts it.

desktop_computer.doc: power_state off/sleep/on/booting. switch_off is an OS shutdown (blocked by unsaved work or updates); cutting power loses data.

laptop_computer.doc: Battery laptop: charges only through its charging port with an adequate charger; on battery it drains at consumption_w.

usb_peripheral.doc: Bus-powered USB device with a captive cable (connect_cable target=device).

external_drive.doc: Storage: disconnect only after eject (disconnect_cable eject_first=true); pulling it mid-transfer corrupts it.

wifi_router.doc: Needs its modem online when it finishes booting, else it shows no internet until restarted again.

rechargeable_device.doc: Battery device: charging rises only through a compatible, powered charger; swollen batteries must never be charged.

earbuds_case.doc: Charges buds seated in their own left/right slots (lid closed keeps them in).

cpap_machine.doc: Powered medical device: never unplug or cut power without the user's or caregiver's explicit instruction.

charger.doc: Mains-powered charger. Wall bricks attach to the outlet (plug_in_place wall) and expose a USB source port.

wireless_charging_pad.doc: Qi pad: a device charges only when its coil is within qi_tolerance_m of coil_center_m (place precisely with spos or use charge).

props.label: charging station
props.label_text: Charging station - USB-C 30W x2, USB-A 12W x2

props.label: AA/AAA battery charger
props.label_text: NiMH battery charger AA/AAA - do NOT charge alkaline or lithium batteries

props.label: 18 V tool battery charger
props.label_text: 18V Li-ion battery charger - charge between 5 and 40 C

tool_battery_charger.doc: Platform charger: refuses packs outside 5-40 C; never charge a swollen pack.

cable.doc: Two-ended cable; ends.<a|b>.at/port show where each end is plugged (connect_cable / disconnect_cable).

battery_cell.doc: Primary or rechargeable cell; charge is hidden until tested (battery tester) or read from sealed packaging (condition). orientation must match the slot's polarity mark.

props.label: CR2032 coin cell
props.label_text: CR2032 3V LITHIUM - keep away from children

light_bulb.doc: Screw/bayonet bulb part (slot accepts part_type). wattage_w is the real draw; fixtures have max_bulb_w.

props.label: LED bulb (60 W equiv., 2700 K)
props.label_text: LED 9W (60W equivalent) 800 lm 2700K soft white - dimmable

props.label: LED bulb (100 W equiv., 2700 K)
props.label_text: LED 14W (100W equivalent) 1600 lm 2700K soft white - dimmable

props.label: LED bulb (non-dimmable, 2700 K)
props.label_text: LED 9W (60W equivalent) 800 lm 2700K soft white - NOT for use with dimmers

props.label: smart LED bulb
props.label_text: Smart LED 9W (60W equivalent) 2200-6500K - Zigbee - to pair, switch the light off and on 3 times

touch_lamp.doc: Touch base cycles off/low/medium/high: switch_on is one tap (low); set level reaches a specific step.

three_way_switch.doc: One of two switches on a 3-way circuit: the light is lit when the two handle positions disagree with the wiring parity, so 'up' does not mean on.

dimmer_switch.doc: level (5-100 %) sets dim_level of the controlled lights; non-dimmable bulbs flicker and fail when dimmed.

load_switch.doc: A wall switch for a non-light load (garbage disposal, exhaust fan) that sits in a bank with light switches.

alarm_unit.doc: Base for smoke/CO alarm units (no battery slot).

smoke_alarm.doc: Twist-lock unit mounted in a detector_base slot. Low battery chirps every ~40 s; units older than 10 years chirp end-of-life.

smoke_alarm_sealed.doc: Sealed 10-year lithium unit: no serviceable battery; replace the whole unit at end of life.

co_alarm.doc: Electrochemical CO alarm with ppm display and peak memory; alarm follows a UL 2034-style dose curve.

detector_base.doc: Ceiling/wall mounting plate. install/uninstall the alarm into slot 'detector' (twist-lock).

alarm_clock.doc: Mains alarm clock: set_time mode=clock|alarm. Volatile clocks reset to a blinking 12:00 after power loss.

remote_control.doc: IR remote (line of sight to the device's receiver, same room) powered by two cells in series.

photocell_light.doc: Dusk-to-dawn fixture: in mode auto it lights only when it is dark outside (and its switch is on).

switched_outlet.doc: Receptacle half controlled by a wall switch (listed in the switch's controls).

hair_dryer.doc: Single-voltage 120 V dryer: on a 230 V supply (or a plug adapter that does not convert) it burns out.

voltage_tester.doc: Pen-style non-contact voltage tester: held while inspecting a receptacle, strip, cord or fixture it beeps and lights when voltage is present (the only way to know a dead outlet from a live one without plugging something in).
